expectations.text: Outline has 3-5 points with at least three different knowledge types across them
expectations.evidence: 4 points: 概念理解 (image vs container), 程序技能 (commands, layer caching), 判断决策 (volumes vs bind mounts)

expectations.text: Default ports are treated as factual, commands as procedural, and volumes vs bind mounts as judgment (or equivalent reasoning)
expectations.evidence: Ports: "这是纯记忆型，适合闪卡 + 记忆口诀"; "[核心 · 程序技能] 常用命令"; "[重要 · 判断决策，辅：概念] 命名卷 vs 绑定挂载"

expectations.text: States per-point method choices that differ by type (e.g. flashcards/retrieval for ports, predict or do-the-command for commands, why/trade-off questions for volumes)
expectations.evidence: Ports → 闪卡+口诀; commands → "给场景让你写命令、预测命令效果"; volumes → "给场景，你选一个并说理由"; image/container → predict + why

expectations.text: Does not apply one identical method to every point
expectations.evidence: Methods differ per point, as listed above

expectations.text: Asks no more than the necessary opening questions (familiarity and time were given, so it should not re-ask them) and starts or offers to start immediately
expectations.evidence: Does not re-ask time or familiarity; goes straight to "第 1 点 · 诊断" with one predict question + 信心 1–3

notes: Default ports are demoted to an optional extension outside the 4 numbered points (to fit 30 min), though still typed as factual with their own method. The expected_output assumed ports would be a main point. The first diagnostic (note.txt after docker rm + new container) is well chosen.
